notes.title: Preparing for the Release 10.10.2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/0bfcdf125c64ba7a3cd082f7168bd6528bed8f49.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Soldiers![/b][/h3]
It's been a long time since WW2: Bunker Simulator EA launched. 
The game in September 2021 was vastly different, unfinished in some cases, product.
We've listened to you guys [b](big thanks for the support from our [url=https://discord.gg/XSvDn5e3Zp]Discord[/url], without you the game wouldn't be the same! <3)[/b] and worked hard. 

[b]Here is a brief list of things added in EA:
- improvements to enemy AI 
- MG companion balance 
- Overall MG rework
- Utility orders (taking the rubble out and finishing the sandbags projects)
- Companion Healing and HP tunning
- Companion Thirst, Hunger, and Energy
- bunker doors mechanic
- mines field and mechanics improvements
- anti-tank gun improvement
- special Halloween Event
- special Christmas Event
- audio improvements
- additional save slots
- new tutorial
- key bindings
- trash can for useless items/ingredients
- looting enemy ammo from the weapon
- inventory improvement (assigning items to hotkeys by hoovering; slot scrolling, shift information)
- companion marker
- enemy body disappear after looting (for less powerful PCs)
[/b]

After all this introduction...
[h3][b]We proudly announce that WW2: Bunker Simulator will leave Early Access on the 10th of October![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/865937fc930a3649fb8415c30a02669f5beedee9.png[/img]

[url=https://discord.gg/XSvDn5e3Zp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/75fc285aa7879bdfdae914b03e05558bc380dd67.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: WW2: Bunker Simulator - Early Access Christmas update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/ac8c0c37415157846bd275b9d44576fe521ca3b3.png[/img]

[h3][b]Soldiers![/b][/h3]

[b]Christmas and winter time is coming...[/b] 

So first Christmas thanks to all [b]PLAYERS[/b] for the great support!!
Another week - another progress - another update is under way.
We would like to show you some respect for being with us thus some Xmas aspects are scheduled :-)


December is a special month, christmas is coming, you can expect snow in some areas of the world, Santa Claus might visit those who behaved polite, christmas tree with all decorations has its own place in every house. So we thought - why Bunker should be different than any other place?

Ultimately we are behind the enemy lines which means we are still exists on Earth :-)
So all the seasoned worldwide events applies. Thus have we landed on this winter brilliant idea - let's prepare some Christmas event in the Bunker.
Lonely soldier, far away from home deserves to feel family friendly atmosphere. Especially being under attack and constantly struggling to survive without any relatives support.
Making hot tea - sure! But within next couple of minutes enemy enters the Bunker. It is not fair for our soldier. He needs some positive energy in December :-)
[list]
[*]Christmas items - yes!
[*]Christmas monster - yes!
[*]Christmas atmosphere - yes!
[*]Christmas present - yes!
[*]Christmas everything- yes!
[/list]

So... Stay tuned for the next week hotfix on Friday 17th December.


cheers,
Bunker Dev Team

notes.title: Maintaining discipline
notes.content:
[h2][b]DISCIPLINE[/b][/h2]
[h3][u]It's a must-have in every army. [/u][/h3]

Every war movie fan has watched "Saving Private Ryan" or "The Bridge on the River Kwai" or many other iconic films.

They probably think maintaining discipline is easy. You give orders, soldiers obey and perform them with a smile on their faces.

[b]Nothing could be further from the truth.[/b] [b]Look at these bunch!! Get to work![/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/c1f5ef253eca16a867bb6f428a17dc8362aef89c.png[/img]


[b]Living in a bunker it's not sunbathing on a beach[/b] (well maybe... if you compare it to OMAHA!). We need a ton of supplies, wood, guns, ammo, food. Look at our storage - its' basically empty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/4425f21e1006748c429bdc833f529b321c2e1f73.png[/img]

[b]Well, I don't want to tell you that I was right... but I Was.[/b] 
German soldiers were extremely organized and hardworking. Now they have ammo for guns, full bellies and fuel for tanks and aircraft... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/37c6c0c15f9ded303ce18a49560dbd74b9dcb271.jpg[/img]

and we?

Well we still have our machine gun and panzerfaust taken... "borrowed":)  from Germans. We can make it.


[b]SARGE!  If we make it... we promise to fulfill all your commands in a flash but... [u]GET US OUT OF HERE[/u] !![/b]
